name: R091-chansey-metronome-transform-then-spite
why: Challenge 1. The player's Chansey 227 calls Metronome 14 turns (slot 0); the foe is Banette 237 (Night Shade, Will-O-Wisp, Spite, Knock Off). A Metronome call of Transform copies Banette's moves (slot 0 becomes Night Shade, still played with prefer 0); Banette's Spite on the transformed Chansey's last move then takes the PP from the copy only (the party record is untouched). Chance per seed about 11/336 x 0.7 = 2%.
